description_en: Enter the state of Ihram at the Miqat. Perform ghusl, wear two white seamless sheets, and make the intention (niyyah) for Umrah.
description_id: Masuk ke keadaan Ihram di Miqat. Mandi sunat, pakai dua helai kain putih tanpa jahitan, dan niatkan Umrah.
dua_translation_en: Here I am, O Allah, for Umrah.
dua_translation_id: Aku datang memenuhi panggilan-Mu ya Allah untuk menunaikan Umrah.

description_en: Recite the Talbiyah frequently throughout Umrah:
description_id: Baca Talbiyah sesering mungkin selama Umrah:
dua_arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
dua_transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal mulk, laa shareeka lak
dua_translation_en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner. Indeed all praise, grace, and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
dua_translation_id: Aku datang memenuhi panggilan-Mu ya Allah, aku datang. Tiada sekutu bagi-Mu. Sesungguhnya segala puji, nikmat, dan kerajaan adalah milik-Mu. Tiada sekutu bagi-Mu.

description_en: Enter Masjid Al-Haram with your right foot. Circle the Kaaba 7 times counterclockwise, starting and ending at the Black Stone. Make dua throughout.
description_id: Masuk Masjidil Haram dengan kaki kanan. Kelilingi Ka'bah 7 kali berlawanan arah jam, dimulai dan diakhiri di Hajar Aswad. Berdoa sepanjang tawaf.
dua_arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
dua_transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar
dua_translation_en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
dua_translation_id: Ya Tuhan kami, berilah kami kebaikan di dunia dan kebaikan di akhirat, dan lindungilah kami dari siksa neraka.

description_en: After Tawaf, pray 2 rakahs behind Maqam Ibrahim (or anywhere in the mosque). Recite Surah Al-Kafirun in the first rakah and Al-Ikhlas in the second.
description_id: Setelah Tawaf, shalat 2 rakaat di belakang Maqam Ibrahim (atau di mana saja dalam masjid). Baca Surah Al-Kafirun di rakaat pertama dan Al-Ikhlas di rakaat kedua.
dua_translation_en: Drink Zamzam water after the prayer — it is for whatever intention you drink it.
dua_translation_id: Minum air Zamzam setelah shalat — ia untuk apa pun niat Anda meminumnya.

description_en: Walk 7 times between Safa and Marwah. Start at Safa, recite the verse (Quran 2:158), make dua, then walk to Marwah. Men run between the green lights.
description_id: Jalan 7 kali antara Safa dan Marwah. Mulai di Safa, baca ayat (QS 2:158), berdoa, lalu berjalan ke Marwah. Laki-laki berlari kecil di antara lampu hijau.
dua_translation_en: At each hill, face the Kaaba and make sincere supplication.
dua_translation_id: Di setiap bukit, hadap Ka'bah dan berdoa dengan khusyuk.

description_en: Men: shave your head completely (Halq) or trim hair evenly (Taqsir). Women: cut a fingertip's length of hair. This completes your Umrah.
description_id: Laki-laki: cukur habis (Halq) atau potong rata (Taqsir). Perempuan: potong seujung jari rambut. Ini menyempurnakan Umrah Anda.
dua_translation_en: Your Umrah is now complete! May Allah accept it. You are now out of Ihram.
dua_translation_id: Umrah Anda selesai! Semoga Allah menerimanya. Anda kini telah keluar dari Ihram.
